verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Weebaze-ekisa kye kingi
Eri bajjajja-ab'edda.
-Olw'ekisa kye-ekitakoma,
Eyaliwo edda n'edda.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
Weebaze Katonda wo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ye Kitaffe,atukuuma,
Atuliisa bulijjo
Amanyi-obunafu bwaffe,
Amanyi-obunafu bwaffe,
Atuwonya mu kabi.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
Weebaze Katonda wo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bamalayika be bonna
Bayimba ettendo lye,
Oyanguwe-ojje n'ebire

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Olye-obwakabaka bwo.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
Weebaze Katonda wo.
